args.sql:
SELECT signalregistry, snrratio, noisefloordbm, (snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm)) as snqi 
FROM signals 
ORDER BY snqi 
LIMIT 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as analyzable,
       SUM(CASE WHEN snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as substandard
FROM signals;

SELECT sc.sigclasstype, COUNT(*) 
FROM signalclassification sc
JOIN signals s ON sc.signalref = s.signalregistry
WHERE s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm) <= 0
GROUP BY sc.sigclasstype;
